Name: Perfume Maker
Author: wilsonch3451
Description:
This mod adds a perfume maker into the game that turns flowers into perfumes.

[b][size=3]This is a custom machine for CustomFarmingRedux, which is required for this to work.

To install, go to Stardew Valley\Mods\CustomFarmingRedux\Machines and put the files inside the .zip into that folder.
[/size][/b]
Currently, the perfumes don't do anything, but you can sell them for more than the flowers sell for. I didn't really have anything to do with the harvested flowers after I used them for honey, so I made this mod. Enjoy!
